lines.en: {i}Legends have it that centuries ago...a single family ruled over all of Kumon-mi.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}传说在几个世纪前……有一个家族统治着整个 Kumon-mi。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Many armies, with the aid of mercenaries and sellswords tried to overthrow this family...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}无数军队曾在佣兵与雇剑客的协助下，试图推翻这个家族……{/i}

lines.en: {i}But every attempt amounted to nothing more than senseless bloodshed and a shameful voyage back home...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但每一次尝试，最终都只化作无谓的流血与可耻的归途……{/i}

lines.en: {i}But one day, after hundreds of years and nearly one thousand fruitless attempts...
lines.zh: {i}然而有一天，在数百年、近千次徒劳的尝试之后……

lines.en: {i}The family that had once ruled over Kumon-mi...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那个曾经统治 Kumon-mi 的家族……{/i}
{i}覆灭了。{/i}
{i}而从那一刻起……{/i}
{i}他们再也没能东山再起。{/i}
{i}直到今天。{/i}
{i}当一个少女开始她的征伐……{/i}
{i}去夺回本就属于她的一切……{/i}

lines.en: Disclaimer: Lessons in Love contains large amounts of information and data that is factually incorrect and no words should be taken as gospel.
lines.zh: 免责声明：Lessons in Love 含有大量与事实不符的信息与数据，其中任何字句都不应被当作真理。

lines.en: : My name is Ayane Amamiya of the Amamiya family...and I am here to take back what is mine!
lines.zh: : 我是 Amamiya 家的 Ayane Amamiya……我是来夺回属于我的东西的！

lines.en: : Oh please...You really expect me to believe that a {i}child{/i} like you aims to take back Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 哦拜托……你真以为像你这样的{i}小孩子{/i}也妄图夺回 Kumon-mi？

lines.en: : Woah, where did that huge lens flare come from?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦，那个巨大的镜头光晕是从哪儿冒出来的？！

lines.en: : This territory belongs to the Arakawas now, little girl...
lines.zh: : 这片土地现在归 Arakawa 家所有了，小丫头……

lines.en: : The Amamiyas have had no place here since the...War of...Blood.
lines.zh: : 自从那场……血之战以后，Amamiya 家在这里就再无立足之地。

lines.en: : Who are you calling a little girl, you pathetic weakling?
lines.zh: : 你叫谁小丫头呢，你这可悲的弱者？

lines.en: : The War of Blood may have ended a long time ago, but the stains it left on these grounds have yet to be forgotten.
lines.zh: : 血之战或许早已结束，但它在这片土地上留下的血迹仍未被人遗忘。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many lives have been taken with just these hands alone? Because it's more than you could possibly fathom.
lines.zh: : 你知道光凭这双手就夺走了多少条性命吗？多得你根本无法想象。

lines.en: : Heed my words, Arakawa. If you have even the {i}slightest{/i} desire to survive, you'll-
lines.zh: : 听好了，Arakawa。如果你心里还有{i}半点{/i}求生的念头，你就——

lines.en: : I’ll what? Walk away from here and give up on Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 我就怎样？乖乖离开这里、放弃 Kumon-mi 吗？

lines.en: : Ahh! There are even more of them now!
lines.zh: : 啊！现在人越来越多了！
: 你疯了吧。

lines.en: : I have spent the last nine thousand years honing my power and-
lines.zh: : 我花了整整九千年打磨我的力量，而且——
: 什么？！九千年？！

lines.en: : There is no way that can be right! Can it?!
lines.zh: : 这怎么可能是对的！难道是真的？！

lines.en: : Nine thousand years is nothing to me.
lines.zh: : 九千年对我来说根本不算什么。

lines.en: : After all, I was born with...
lines.zh: : 毕竟，我生来就拥有……
: {i}那个{/i}血统……
: 什么？！{i}那个{/i}血统？！
: 没错……
: {i}那个{/i}血统！！！

lines.en: : This can't be...all this time I thought {i}I{/i} was the protagonist, but...
lines.zh: : 不可能……我一直以为{i}我{/i}才是主角，可是……
: 如果他拥有{i}那个{/i}血统……

lines.en: : Could this be the end of my journey?...
lines.zh: : 难道我的旅程就要就此终结了吗？……
: 不可能……
: 不能在我牺牲了这么多之后……

lines.en: : I’ve come too far to give up now...there has to be {i}something{/i} I can do...
lines.zh: : 我已经走了太远，不能现在放弃……一定有{i}什么{/i}是我能做的……

lines.en: : It’s over, Ayane...I have the high ground.
lines.zh: : 结束了，Ayane……高地在我这边。

lines.en: : We’re on the same level! You're just a little taller!
lines.zh: : 我们明明在同一高度！你只是个子高点而已！

lines.en: : But, you see...that’s where you’re wrong...
lines.zh: : 可是啊……你错就错在这里……

lines.en: : You and I will {i}never{/i} be on the same level...
lines.zh: : 你和我{i}永远{/i}不可能站在同一高度……

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter how much you train or how many of my underlings you defeat...
lines.zh: : 无论你怎么训练，无论你打败我多少个手下……

lines.en: : This is the end of the road. Defeating me isn’t possible...
lines.zh: : 这就是路的尽头。想打败我是不可能的……

lines.en: : Then you leave me no choice...
lines.zh: : 那你就是不给我留选择的余地了……
: 不……不可能！
: 可能！

lines.en: : You’ve given me no choice but to unleash the Amamiya family’s hidden technique!
lines.zh: : 你逼得我别无选择，只能解放 Amamiya 家的隐藏奥义了！

lines.en: : Amamiya, for the last time, put that thing away! You’re going to get us shut down!
lines.zh: : Amamiya，最后说一次，把那玩意儿收起来！你会害我们被查封的！

lines.en: : Miss Osaka! Turn the fan speed up! My hair isn't blowing fast enough!
lines.zh: : Osaka 小姐！把风扇转速调高！我的头发飘得还不够快！
: 我们没有——

lines.en: : Wait, where did this giant fan even come from?!
lines.zh: : 等等，这台巨大的风扇到底是从哪儿来的？！

lines.en: : I’m sorry things have to end this way...
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，事情要以这种方式收场……

lines.en: : You deserve the death of a warrior, not that of a dog.
lines.zh: : 你该拥有战士的死法，而不是像条狗一样死去。
: 哈哈哈……
: ……有什么好笑的？
: 哈哈哈哈哈！
: 等等……不会吧……
: 他{i}不可能{/i}是……
: 但我可以……

lines.en: : You’ve fallen into my trap, little girl.
lines.zh: : 你落入我的陷阱了，小丫头。
: 你看……
: 我生来就{i}免疫{/i}子弹。
: 不！这不可能！
: 可能！

lines.en: The staredown between the two fierce warriors goes on for hours...
lines.zh: 两名凶悍战士之间的对峙持续了数小时……
数天……
数周……
上千年……

lines.en: But the sheer respect for one another’s power is enough to force them into exercising more caution than they ever have before.
lines.zh: 但彼此对对方实力的由衷敬意，足以迫使他们拿出前所未有的谨慎。

lines.en: {i}This{/i} was the moment they had lived for...
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}就是他们一直为之而活的瞬间……

lines.en: The moment to finally prove who the rightful ruler of Kumon-mi is!
lines.zh: 终于可以证明谁才是 Kumon-mi 正统统治者的瞬间！
{i}结局将会如何？！{/i}
{i}谁会取胜？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Will Ayane Amamiya take back the land her family had all but built with their bare hands?!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane Amamiya 能夺回她家族用双手一寸寸建起的土地吗？！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Will the mysterious ronin, clad only in sweatpants and a T-shirt, be able to fend off the legendary Amamiya fighting style?!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那位只穿着运动裤和 T 恤的神秘浪人，能挡下传说中的 Amamiya 流派吗？！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Find out next time on Lessons in Love ~ The Battle for Kumon-mi!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}敬请期待下期 Lessons in Love ~ Kumon-mi 之战！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}本节目由 Koi Cafe 部分赞助播出！[[copyrighted frozen beverage]的故乡！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}白天太长？夜晚太短？来 Koi Cafe 尝尝由可爱女孩们亲手调制的特色饮品吧！{/i}
{i}下次再见！{/i}

lines.en: : So yeah, that’s basically how you do karate.
lines.zh: : 所以呢，基本就是这样打空手道的。

lines.en: : Are you two seriously just going to leave this thing here?! What am I supposed to do about this?!
lines.zh: : 你们俩该不会真打算把这玩意儿丢在这儿吧？！我该拿它怎么办？！

lines.en: : I feel like I actually did pretty well.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我其实打得挺不错的。

lines.en: : Yeah, you were surprisingly good. You really had me going with that whole bloodline thing.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你出人意料地厉害。那套血统的说辞还真把我唬住了。

lines.en: : Thanks. Came up with that off the top of my head. Totally not a play on a mildly obscure video series from 2009.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。那是我临场现编的。绝对不是拿 2009 年一部有点冷门的影像系列在玩梗。

lines.en: : Wow, that seems so long ago.
lines.zh: : 哇，那听起来是很久以前的事了。

lines.en: : Yeah. We’re dying faster than we like to admit.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们消亡的速度，比自己愿意承认的要快。

lines.en: : Well, you are at least. I’m a perfectly healthy, able-bodied [young_girl] who is going to take back her family’s land through martial arts!
lines.zh: : 至少你是这样。我可是个健康健全的[young_girl]，要凭武术夺回家族的土地！

lines.en: : Just remember, you’ll have to defeat me first.
lines.zh: : 别忘了，你得先打败我才行。

lines.en: : Seriously. What the fuck am I supposed to do about this?
lines.zh: : 说真的。我到底该拿这玩意儿怎么办？

lines.en: : Pfft. You make it sound like defeating you is supposed to be a challenge.
lines.zh: : 噗。听你这口气，好像打败你是什么难事似的。

lines.en: : It will be now that you know I’m immune to bullets.
lines.zh: : 现在你知道我免疫子弹了，那就是难事了。

lines.en: : Also, where the hell did you get that gun? It looked real.
lines.zh: : 还有，你他妈从哪儿弄来的那把枪？看着像真的。

lines.en: : There are three things you never ask a lady, Sensei! Her age, her weight, and where she got her automatic rifle.
lines.zh: : Sensei，有三件事永远不该问一位女士！她的年龄、她的体重，还有她的自动步枪是从哪儿弄来的。

lines.en: : I don’t remember ever learning about that last one.
lines.zh: : 我不记得学过最后那一条。

lines.en: : Then maybe it’s time to start studying up!
lines.zh: : 那也许是时候开始补课了！

lines.en: : When you aren’t too busy training to defeat me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，在你忙着训练要打败我的空档里。
: 对，对。

lines.en: : Anyway, we should probably get a move on before the instructor asks us to do something about the industrial size fan you had air lifted here for our sparring match today.
lines.zh: : 总之，我们大概该走了，免得教官让我们处理你今天为了这场对练空运过来的那台工业级风扇。

lines.en: : Yeah. It's a good thing she hasn't noticed it yet.
lines.zh: : 是啊。好在目前她还没发现。

lines.en: : I want this thing gone in ten minutes or the two of you aren't allowed back anymore.
lines.zh: : 十分钟内把这玩意儿弄走，否则你们俩以后都不准再来。
: 我再叫一架直升机过来……

lines.en: Ayane and I finish up our ‘karate’ routine for the day and change back into our normal clothes while waiting for the helicopter to arrive.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我结束了今天的「空手道」流程，换回常服，等着直升机到达。

lines.en: Unfortunately, she has to feed her chicken after this, so the two of us need to break apart and go our separate ways.
lines.zh: 可惜她之后还得去喂她的鸡，所以我们俩要就此分开、各走各路。

lines.en: Without anything left to do, I depart the dojo and begin to wander the streets in search of something to close out the day with...
lines.zh: 再无事可做，我离开道场，开始在街上闲逛，想找点事情来结束这一天……
{i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！{/i}
